email_body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Market Development Specialist, Belgium role at the Marine Stewardship Council. Having followed the MSC's mission to end overfishing, I am inspired by the opportunity to contribute to the growth of sustainable seafood in Belgium.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I build and maintain client websites, manage SEO and content strategies, and support CRM follow-up for a cleaning-services client. This experience has honed my ability to manage multiple projects, communicate with stakeholders, and use data to drive decisions. I am eager to apply these skills to build relationships with retailers, foodservice operators, and other supply chain partners.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level and actively improving. I am confident in my ability to engage with Dutch-speaking partners and am committed to reaching full professional proficiency.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my background in digital marketing and client support can translate into successful market development for MSC.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
